reel_angle.fan_question: Did the penalty lose Chelsea the game?
reel_angle.data_answer: No. Chelsea had 69% of the ball and 0.53 xG; Sunderland's open-play xG alone was 1.38 to Chelsea's 0.32, before the penalty (0.79 xG) is counted.
